title: Collect the Coin
glitch: The coin disappears, but the score stays at 0.

title: Jump Button
glitch: The player jumps when the button is not pressed.

title: Door Key
glitch: The player has the key, but the locked door will not open.

title: Health Pickup
glitch: The heart pickup makes the player lose health.

title: Moving Platform
glitch: The platform moves left when the game says to move right.

title: Too Many Lives
glitch: The life counter jumps up after the player gets hit.

title: Finish Line
glitch: The player reaches the finish, but the level does not end.

title: Enemy Patrol
glitch: The enemy walks away from the edge and falls off the platform.

title: Countdown Timer
glitch: The countdown timer grows instead of shrinking.

title: Full Energy Bar
glitch: Energy goes above its maximum after collecting a battery.

title: Wrong Way Sign
glitch: The game shows WRONG WAY while the player moves toward the goal.

title: Balloon Pop
glitch: The balloon pops before the dart reaches it.

title: Open Chest
glitch: The chest opens even when the player is standing far away.

title: Level Gate
glitch: The gate opens before the player collects all three stars.

title: Quiet Footsteps
glitch: Footstep sound plays while the player is standing still.

title: Dodge Roll
glitch: The player keeps rolling after the roll button is released.

title: Water Splash
glitch: The player takes damage while safely standing on dry ground.

title: Checkpoint
glitch: The checkpoint saves the starting spawn point instead of the new one.

title: Break the Brick
glitch: The brick remains solid after its health reaches zero.

title: Potion Use
glitch: The potion is consumed but does not restore magic.

title: Collect All Gems
glitch: The level ends after the first gem.

title: High Score
glitch: A lower score overwrites the best score.

title: Red Light
glitch: The player can move during the red light.

title: Pause Menu
glitch: The game keeps updating while the pause menu is open.

title: Wrong Door
glitch: The player enters the red door when choosing the blue door.

title: Bridge Repair
glitch: The bridge is repaired while the player has no wood.

title: Target Practice
glitch: A target is counted as hit when the shot misses to the left.

title: Race Lap Counter
glitch: The lap counter decreases when the car crosses the finish line.

title: Hide in the Bush
glitch: The player is marked hidden while standing in the open.

title: Collect the Ammo
glitch: Ammo is consumed when the player picks up a box.
